MintDex introduces an interesting concept which turns every launched memecoin into a unique, evolving, and tradable NFT collectible card.
Think of it as a combination of Pump.fun, Pokémon-style collectible cards, and a revenue-sharing mechanism tied to token trading activity.

The system revolves around four components:
- Token creation: Tokens are launched through Pump.fun, with contract addresses ending in mint.
- NFT integration: Each token is associated with a unique collectible NFT card using Metaplex infrastructure.
- Dynamic evolution: Cards visually evolve as their associated tokens reach specific market capitalization milestones.
- NFT marketplace: Users can collect, transfer, and trade these cards independently of the underlying tokens.

One of MintDex's most interesting features is its progression system.
Each card can unlock up to 14 visual tiers as its associated token reaches higher market cap

Loom 是编织机的意思。取名 loomore，就是希望把作者的创意、AI 的能力和每个参与者的选择，编织在一起。

你可以走进一部 AI 互动小说，用自己的话改变故事走向；也可以玩一场 AI 跑团，让 AI 当主持人，一个人展开冒险。故事记得你做过的事，结局由你一步步走出来。

互动小说、跑团，只是开始。还有更多 AI 创意，等着大家一起编织进去。

REPORT: The daughter of Kim Jong-un, who is reportedly close to being designated the future dictator of North Korea, may face a deadly succession fight with her own aunt, according to the Telegraph.

South Korean spies allege 13-year-old Kim Ju Ae has already started training to lead the country.

According to former South Korean ambassador Ra Jong Yil, Kim's daughter might face a challenge from Kim Yo Jong, her aunt, who has strong military support in North Korea.

"It depends on the timing, but I believe if Kim Yo Jong believed that she had a chance of becoming the top leader, then she would take it," Ra said to The Telegraph.

"For her, there are no reasons to refrain from putting into effect her own political project."

Raa said a power struggle is probable.
